name: SearchRestaurant
description: Allows users to search for restaurant information based on various filters.

required_parameters.name: area
required_parameters.description: The area where the restaurant is located.

optional_parameters.name: priceRange
optional_parameters.description: The price range of the restaurant.

optional_parameters.name: food
optional_parameters.description: Type of food or cuisine offered.

optional_parameters.name: return_info
optional_parameters.description: Information to be returned, can include options such as 'all', 'name', 'address', 'phone'.

name: BookRestaurant
description: Allows users to make restaurant reservations.

required_parameters.name: people
required_parameters.description: Number of people for the reservation.

optional_parameters.name: return_info
optional_parameters.description: Information that will be returned, including options such as 'all', 'name', 'phone', 'address', 'postcode'.

name: searchHotel
description: To search for hotels based on a set of criteria including rating, type, amenities, location, and price range.

optional_parameters.name: stars
optional_parameters.description: The hotel rating based on stars.

optional_parameters.name: parking
optional_parameters.description: Availability of parking at the hotel.

optional_parameters.name: internet
optional_parameters.description: Availability of internet service at the hotel.

optional_parameters.name: area
optional_parameters.description: The location area of the hotel.

optional_parameters.name: priceRange
optional_parameters.description: The price range of the hotel.

optional_parameters.name: return_info
optional_parameters.description: A list specifying the fields to be returned.

name: bookHotel
description: To book hotels by providing booking date, hotel name, duration of stay, number of people, and specifying fields to be returned.

optional_parameters.name: name
optional_parameters.description: The hotel name for the booking.

optional_parameters.name: stay
optional_parameters.description: The number of days to stay at the hotel.

optional_parameters.name: people
optional_parameters.description: The number of people for the booking.

optional_parameters.name: return_info
optional_parameters.description: Fields to be returned after booking.
